findings.statement: March 2025 total revenue was 51,929.10 based on 337 transactions.
findings.method: SQL aggregation with date_trunc to group by month and SUM revenue
findings.code: SELECT date_trunc('month', date) as month, SUM(revenue) as total_revenue, COUNT(*) as row_count FROM monthly_revenue WHERE date >= '2025-03-01' AND date < '2025-05-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', date) ORDER BY month

findings.statement: April 2025 total revenue was 54,166.66 based on 315 transactions.
findings.method: SQL aggregation with date_trunc to group by month and SUM revenue
findings.code: SELECT date_trunc('month', date) as month, SUM(revenue) as total_revenue, COUNT(*) as row_count FROM monthly_revenue WHERE date >= '2025-03-01' AND date < '2025-05-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', date) ORDER BY month
